canon: CANON.md ## 7. THE NEW VESSELS — JIN KAZAMA: the Bloodline Soul. Not the SOUL JIN (the blade's soul); this is the character, heir of the Mishima bloodline, the Devil Gene made flesh. Element: Fire — the Plains of Chi-U.
character: Jin Kazama — The Bloodline Soul (Western Heart roster/jin)

coordinate_system.note: All entries are full-texture replacements at the texture's native size. Re-embed the PNG as the named image index in the reskinned GLB to apply.
coordinate_system.pixel_space: x right, y DOWN, origin top-left of the PNG as stored in the GLB

entries.name: Torso — Bloodline Ember (devil-gene flame marking)
entries.notes: Bare chest kept; skin cooled to an ashen tone. Symmetric devil-gene flame-tribal marking fanned across the upper chest with a sternum ember emblem. White UV islands (arm/neck cutouts) and nipples masked out — untouched.

entries.name: Pants flame decal — ember crimson
entries.notes: Flame decal overlay (transparent background preserved). Orange/yellow flames hue-shifted to deep crimson ember, tips darkened. Same flame shapes, devil-gene heat.

entries.name: Pants — deepened black with ember warmth
entries.notes: Black gi pants deepened; faint ember-red warmth lifted in the weave. Subtle — the flame decal carries the motif.

entries.name: Obi — ember crimson cords
entries.notes: Black obi kept black; pale gold stripes/cords recolored to ember crimson.

entries.name: Eye iris — original (restore)
entries.notes: Jin's original brown eye-iris, byte-identical to game/assets/models/jin.glb. Re-embed to restore exactly. The yellow tiger variant lives in customization/parts/jin-eyes/ as a swappable option — defaults never overwritten.

how_to_swap: 1. Pick a reskin PNG from entries.
2. Re-embed it as the listed glb_image_index in roster/jin/attires/bloodline-ember/jin-bloodline-ember.glb (same procedure as the build: replace the image bufferView bytes).
3. To restore a texture exactly: re-embed the *-original.png.
4. Eyes: see customization/parts/jin-eyes/MANIFEST.json — eye-yellow-tiger.png is a drop-in 128x128 swap for eye-iris.
reskin_concept: Devil-gene accents on a dark base: ember-crimson flame motifs, ashen skin, devil-gene flame-tribal chest marking. Keeps the Bloodline Soul menace.
source: Owner directive 2026-10-18: give each character their first custom look — reskin/retexture following the Pantera pattern, option libraries, T-pose re-renders, own-eyes verification.
